energy_opportunities.action: Enable robot auto-standby after 120 s idle
energy_opportunities.evidence: R-01, R-02, R-03, R-04 and others accumulated 1143 idle/blocked minutes consuming 0.4 kW each (7.62 kWh so far this shift).
energy_opportunities.estimate_note: upper bound (all idle time); actual saving depends on idle episode lengths vs the standby threshold — verify with Energy What-if
energy_opportunities.throughput_impact: none — applies only while idle or blocked

energy_opportunities.action: Stop conveyors while no parts are in transit
energy_opportunities.evidence: Conveyors ran empty for 87 minutes (1.74 kWh at 1.2 kW).
energy_opportunities.throughput_impact: none — restart is instant in this model

energy_opportunities.action: Put CNCs into standby while waiting for parts
energy_opportunities.evidence: CNC-01/02 idled at 1.6 kW for 4 minutes (0.11 kWh).
energy_opportunities.throughput_impact: warm-up modelled as instant; real CNCs may need scheduling around it

flow_insight.reason: Machine Tending is the current constraint: utilization 98% vs line average 67%. Its standalone capacity is 160 u/h — the lowest on the line — while upstream Assembly could produce 360 u/h, so the line paces at 156.0 u/h. B02 (Assembly→Machine Tending) has remained full for 7540 seconds, blocking 3 of 4 Assembly stations.
